rule: Approval attaches to results, not to tasks. Work is filed without asking; only acting on it is gated, and only by how hard it is to walk back.

0.name: Just do it
0.means: Nothing to walk back — reading, drafting, analysing, rendering, running the suites.
0.gate: none; the result is what he reviews

1.name: Do it, show the diff
1.means: Changes files, but git reverts it — doc edits, code behind tests, a new decision card.
1.gate: a build session does it and shows the diff afterwards

2.name: Ask first
2.means: Hard to walk back or his taste to settle — shipping, spending, deleting, anything players see, any change of design direction.

consider: A question from Daniel, or anything he asks the studio to consider, look into, weigh, or think about, is tier-0 work: reading, analysing and recommending, which nobody needs permission for. File the consideration, owned by whoever holds the answer, with a first step that produces a recommendation. Never file the action he is asking about as if he had asked for it — that is filed later, at its own tier, when he accepts the recommendation.
comment: A comment on a card is not a verdict and needs no button. Its owner answers it on the card and makes one of three moves, named on the card: answer (the reply settles it), revise (the owner extends the existing result and it comes back for review), or follow-up (new work filed to the right person, linked to the card).
arrival: Ruled 2026-09-20 (S-16). A finished card reaches Daniel only when a wrong answer with nobody reviewing it would be hard to walk back, or the answer is his taste to settle. Everything else lands on its own and is reported in a digest with an Undo per line. The landing bar, checked by the machine and written on the card: tier 0 or 1; both suites green on a clean worktree at HEAD plus exactly the card's diff; checker pass, or concerns with every finding fixed in the same landing; human-facing text past the writing check; nothing in the diff on the tier-2 list. A card that fails the bar goes back to its owner, never to him. The checker re-judges the tier from the diff it read.
spawn: Ruled 2026-09-20 (S-17). His yes on a card covers what the card said it would start; those follow-ups file at their own tier and land under the arrival rule, returning only if the result differs from what was promised. A follow-up that is hard to walk back enters his queue only once prepped as a question with options and a recommendation. Nothing without a recommendation may enter his queue. A follow-up with no tier named is tier 1. A follow-up whose owner and subject match an open card merges into it. A follow-up of a follow-up is still under the original yes.

states.landed: Committed under the arrival rule; reported, not judged. Undo reverts the commit and reopens the card.
states.owed: He asked something the owner could not answer within thirty seconds; the studio's move, and it returns to the top of his list with the answer.
